# Pull request

## Safety checklist

These checks are required for every human-authored pull request.

- [ ] **Public data and confidentiality:** All content is approved for public
      release and contains no internal-only or customer-confidential material
- [ ] **Secrets and credentials:** No real credentials, tokens, connection
      strings, tenant IDs, subscription IDs, or private keys are included
- [ ] **Privacy:** Examples use synthetic data and contain no personal data,
      customer data, private prompts, model outputs, or notebook outputs
- [ ] **Responsible AI:** I assessed AI-related changes for potential harms,
      evaluation needs, guardrails, human oversight, and misuse; or this change
      does not include an AI system
- [ ] **Sample safety:** Code and deployment examples use secure defaults,
      pinned dependencies where practical, least privilege, and clear
      production-readiness limitations

See [SECURITY_TESTING.md](../SECURITY_TESTING.md) for the automated controls,
review criteria, and exception process.

## Content checklist

Before submitting, confirm all of the following:

- [ ] Every technical claim links to an authoritative source
      (Microsoft Learn or a product-owned repo)
- [ ] No pricing or credit amounts are stated —
      official sources are linked instead
- [ ] `owners.md` is updated if path content changed
- [ ] All links have been tested and are not broken
- [ ] Content follows the voice and tone rules in `CONTRIBUTING.md`
      (developer-first, no superlatives, short sentences)
- [ ] No content duplicates what lives in Microsoft Learn
      or product documentation
